nodes.text: #China is experiencing a rise in #respiratory #illnesses, including human #metapneumovirus (#HMPV), according to reports. Reports and social media posts suggest the #virus is spreading rapidly, with some claiming #hospitals and #crematoriums are overwhelmed.
